class.name: DebugDraw
class.brief_description: Immediate-mode debug drawing of lines, shapes and gizmos in a running game.
class.description: DebugDraw draws temporary wireframe shapes into the main viewport from any script, without creating nodes or meshes. It is the equivalent of Unity's [code]Debug.DrawLine[/code], [code]Debug.DrawRay[/code] and [code]Gizmos.Draw*[/code]. Use it to visualize raycast results, velocities, paths, trigger volumes and AI state. Each shape has a [code]duration[/code] in seconds. With the default of [code]0[/code] a shape is shown for one rendered frame, so draw it every frame from [method Node._process] or [method Node._physics_process]: [codeblocks] [gdscript] func _physics_process(delta): var hit = get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query) if hit: DebugDraw.sphere(hit.position, 0.1, Color.RED) DebugDraw.arrow(hit.position, hit.position + hit.normal, Color.YELLOW) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] Shapes are drawn on top of the 3D scene (depth tested, see [member depth_test]) and of the 2D canvas. [b]Note:[/b] Debug drawing is enabled by default only in debug builds. Set [member enabled] explicitly to use it in a release build.

method.name: aabb
method.description: Draws the edges of an axis-aligned box in world space.

method.name: arrow
method.description: Draws a line from [param from] to [param to] with an arrowhead of length [param head_size] at [param to].

method.name: arrow_2d
method.description: 2D version of [method arrow], in world pixels.

method.name: axes
method.description: Draws the X (red), Y (green) and Z (blue) axes of [param transform], each [param size] long. Useful to see the orientation of a node or a bone.

method.name: box
method.description: Draws the edges of a box with the given total [param size], centered on and oriented by [param transform].

method.name: circle
method.description: Draws a circle lying in the plane perpendicular to [param normal].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every shape that is currently queued, including shapes with a long [param duration].

method.name: get_segment_count_2d
method.description: Returns the number of 2D line segments currently queued. Mostly useful to check that debug output does not grow without bound.

method.name: get_segment_count_3d
method.description: Returns the number of 3D line segments currently queued.

method.name: line
method.description: Draws a line between two world-space points. A [param duration] of [code]0[/code] shows the line for exactly one rendered frame, so call this every frame from [method Node._process] or [method Node._physics_process] to keep it visible. A positive duration keeps it for that many seconds.

method.name: line_2d
method.description: 2D version of [method line]. Positions are in world coordinates, so the drawing follows the active [Camera2D].

method.name: path
method.description: Draws connected line segments through [param points]. If [param closed] is [code]true[/code] the last point connects back to the first.

method.name: point
method.description: Marks a position with a three-axis cross that is [param size] wide.

method.name: ray
method.description: Draws a line from [param origin] along [param direction]. The length of [param direction] is the length of the line, as with Unity's [code]Debug.DrawRay[/code].

method.name: rect_2d
method.description: Draws the outline of a rectangle in 2D world coordinates.

method.name: sphere
method.description: Draws a wire sphere made of three orthogonal circles, each with [param segments] segments.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], 3D shapes are hidden behind scene geometry. If [code]false[/code] they are always drawn on top.
If [code]false[/code], every drawing call does nothing and queued shapes are removed. The default is [code]true[/code] in debug builds and [code]false[/code] in release builds.
